sections.heading: 1. Purpose and Scope
sections.body: This clause set defines the AI risk-mitigation obligations that {org_name}, as a governmental entity, imposes on vendors that procure, develop, or deploy AI systems on its behalf within {boundary}, operationalizing the contractual vendor requirements of Texas SB 1964. Aligned to the statute; not legal advice, and contract language should be reviewed by counsel.

sections.heading: 2. Vendor AI Risk-Mitigation Obligations

questions.prompt: Which risk-management standard must vendors align to (for example, NIST AI RMF)?
What evidence must vendors provide (for example, impact assessments, performance metrics, material-change notices)?
Which obligations must the vendor flow down to any sub-processors or model providers?

sections.body: A vendor providing AI systems to {org_name} shall: align its AI risk management to {vendor_risk_standard}; provide {vendor_evidence} on request and before deployment; notify {org_name} of any material change to the system, its data, or its intended use; and flow down {vendor_flowdown} to sub-processors. These obligations are tracked per contract and evidenced during the relationship.
